eas_text: A civil authority has issued A SHELTER IN PLACE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Coconino, AZ; at 1:33 PM on AUG 24, 2022 Effective until 5:33 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Flash Flooding Expected in the areas of Creighton Estates, Cheshire, Coconino Estates, Coyote Springs, Anasazi Ridge and the Highway 180 corridor.

If indoors, shelter in place.  If outdoors, get to high ground and do not enter drainages. Know where your children and pets are and do not let children play near drainages. Please stay safe.
